2026.60+machines on the strength floorAbout usMore than a strength floorMasters Way Sports Club opened in Ar Rihab, Buraidah, in 2018. A strength floor equipped with Life Fitness and Hammer Strength machines, a functional training area, and group classes for every fitness level.After training there's an indoor pool, a hot and cold jacuzzi, a sauna and a steam room, all in your membership, with certified coaches on the floor from day one.American machinesLife Fitness and Hammer Strength, plus free weights.Group classesHIIT, HYROX and Boot Camp, in your membership.Indoor poolGraded depth, with the water tested daily.RecoveryHot and cold jacuzzi, sauna and steam room.ProgramsPrograms led by specialistsSession packages for one-to-one guidance. Questions and bookings go through the club's WhatsApp for now.Personal trainingOne-to-one sessions with a coach at the club, starting with an assessment and a plan for your goal.8–30 sessionsPackages and prices8 sessions990 SAR12 sessions1,428 SAR24 sessions2,688 SAR30 sessions2,999 SARAsk on WhatsAppSports injury rehabilitationSessions for a gradual return to training after injury, starting with an initial assessment.Not physiotherapy or a medical diagnosis, and it requires medical clearance to return to activity.6–24 sessionsFrom 720 SARPackages and prices6 sessions720 SAR12 sessions1,320 SAR18 sessions1,890 SAR24 sessions2,400 SARAsk on WhatsAppAdult swimming lessonsFrom zero in the indoor pool, with a coach who specialises in teaching swimming.6–18 sessionsFrom 690 SARPackages and prices6 sessions690 SAR12 sessions1,150 SAR18 sessions1,990 SARAsk on WhatsAppCoaching teamCertified coaches with you from day oneAlways on the floor to help. For one-to-one coaching, personal training comes in packages of set sessions.About personal trainingMember reviewsWhat our members sayThe club's Google rating, and member reviews published there. Reviews are quoted in Arabic as written.4.5Google ratingfrom 1,841 reviewsAs shown on the club's website on 25 November 2026.5 out of 5 stars«النادي جداً جداً نظيف وجميع الأجهزة متوفرة على جميع العضلات، نادي متكامل بما تعنيه الكلمة، والكوتش مجدي متعاون وأسلوبه ممتاز.»مسعود الحربيGoogle5 out of 5 stars«نادي المسار ممتاز وحالياً لي 4 سنوات فيه ولا فكرت أغيره؛ المدربين ما يقصرون ويمشون معنا خطوة خطوة ويرفعون معنوياتنا.»majed mohammadGoogle5 out of 5 stars«نادي رياضي رجالي ممتاز في بريدة. أعجبني تنوع الأجهزة والنظافة ووجود مسبح وساونا بعد التمرين، والبيئة هادئة ومريحة.»Nfin PerfumesGoogleOpening hoursWhen can you train?The club is open every day of the week, and the pool has its own hours.ClubSaturday – Thursday6:00 AM – 2:00 AMFriday1:00 PM – 12:00 AMPoolSaturday – Thursday8:00 AM – 11:30 PMFriday3:00 PM – 9:00 PMOutside pool hours, the time is used for water treatment and pool care.Hours may change on holidays and official occasions, so check before you visit.+ 2 months free · With the 12 months membershipStart your membership today.Choose your duration, and the club team will contact you to activate it.Choose a membershipMen aged 18 and over · Membership starts from activation at the clubContact usVisit or message usWrite your question and WhatsApp opens with a ready message that you send yourself.Send your questionNameMobile number (optional)What are you interested in?ChooseClub membershipPersonal trainingInjury rehabilitationSwimming lessonsFriends offerYour message (optional)Send on WhatsAppWe don't store what you write here: it only goes to WhatsApp, and nothing is sent until you press send there.Or message us directly on WhatsAppAddress4870 Northern Ring Road, 8177, Ar Rihab, Buraidah 52581Call us016 324 0111WhatsAppEmailMmastersway@gmail.comOpening hoursSaturday – Thursday6:00 AM – 2:00 AMFriday1:00 PM – 12:00 AMAr Rihab, BuraidahOpen the mapA men's sports club in Ar Rihab, Buraidah.
